verdict.rationale: Unity documents a first-party MCP server connecting LLM agents (Claude Code, Cursor) to the Editor for creating assets, automating workflows, analyzing performance, and performing project actions via natural-language/programmatic prompts (unity-docs-23, unity-docs-24, unity-probe-4), alongside a scriptable C# API for scenes/inspectors/properties (unity-docs-10, unity-docs-11) and CLI/command-line automation for builds and CI (unity-docs-6, unity-docs-7, unity-docs-25, unity-docs-28). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the MCP server's reliability/coverage and explicit documentation of scene/node creation specifically via MCP tools rather than general scripting API.
